title: Windows 11's built-in Weather app wastes more than 1 GB of RAM
summary: This article discusses a performance issue in Windows 11's built-in Weather app, which consumes over 1 GB of RAM. The discussion on Hacker News focuses on the app's resource inefficiency, potential causes (e.g., background updates, web-based UI), and user workarounds. It highlights broader concerns about bloatware and system resource management in modern operating systems.
